description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TikTok is a short-form mobile video platform with a global e-commerce business focused on helping users discover and purchase products. The Backend Software Engineer will develop and integrate scalable, secure supply chain and logistics services for TikTok Shop, optimize backend systems, and promote engineering excellence across product development.
Backend engineer building secure, scalable e-commerce supply chain and logistics services

Responsibilities:
• Develop efficient, highly scalable and secured services to build/integrate Supply Chain & Logistics system for domestic and global TikTok Shop E-commerce
• Optimize backend systems and services for data security, modularity, computational efficiency and scalability
• Deliver best-in-class engineering excellence practices across all product engineering disciplines

Requirements:
• Bachelors or higher degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
• 1 year experience developing highly scalable backend services and systems using at least one of Java/Go/Python/C++

Preferred:
• Experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transportation, Delivery Technology, and/or Warehousing
• Experience in E-commerce and retail related fields
• Experience in full stack development

Pay: $122K/yr - $243K/yr
